findings.namedBuyers: Two verified commercial routing candidates: Mike Marino, VP, Sales & Business Development, for partnership/vendor introductions; Aaron West, President, for senior routing to conference operations and housing. Both roles appear on MoneyShow’s leadership page. Neither is verified as the Toronto hotel-contract signatory or housing buyer. Public shared channel: Support@MoneyShow.com; +1 941-955-0323. No personal email or direct telephone verified.
findings.futureEdition: No officially published next Toronto edition was found. Cantonfair lists September 16–17, 2027 at MaRS Centre, but explicitly says to double-check with the organizer. The official Toronto page still identifies September 24–25, 2026, already past as of 2026-11-16 and outside the requested future horizon. Do not qualify the secondary 2027 dates or venue as confirmed; upcoming verified dates and venue remain null.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications and published event format: a Toronto city-hotel opportunity, not a resort-led meeting. Radisson Blu’s 157 rooms and approximately 240-theatre largest room cannot replace a conference marketed to hundreds or thousands. Plausible roles are a separately negotiated speaker/executive or sponsor room allotment, small side meeting, or reception—not exclusive event housing. A 15–109 peak-room allocation is a hotel sales screening range, NOT published event demand. Historical MTCC editions fit the supplied walkable-MTCC positioning better than the College Street MaRS location. No group size, room demand or catering order is evidenced. Verify restaurant/lounge and banquet service before promising food-and-beverage delivery.
findings.venueCommitments: Historical official 2026 venue: MaRS Centre, MaRS Discovery District, 101 College Street, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. This is Toronto proper, in the downtown College Street area, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. The official site calls it a NEW VENUE. The 2027 MaRS listing is secondary evidence only; no future venue contract or official commitment verified. Third-party 2026 listings naming Chelsea as the event venue conflict with the later official MaRS announcement and are not used as venue authority.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified edition timeline: September 8–9, 2023, September 13–14, 2024 and September 12–13, 2025 at Metro Toronto Convention Centre North; September 24–25, 2026 at MaRS Centre. This demonstrates repeated Toronto editions and a within-city venue change, not a destination rotation or confirmed annual future commitment.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Published pathway: the official Toronto site names only THE CHELSEA HOTEL, TORONTO, 33 Gerrard Street W. Exact wording: “Guests may call the hotel directly, toll-free at 1-800-CHELSEA (243-5732) or 416-595-1975.” The page title is “Official Hotel for MoneyShow Toronto” but the page has no edition/year, stay dates, negotiated rate, block quantity, booking code or cutoff. Treat this as an existing official-hotel relationship, not an edition-specific booking commitment. No verified 2027 housing bureau, open hotel RFP, additional hotel, room block or room-night commitment was found. Future sourcing status is unconfirmed, not open.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate financial-education conference producer, not an association. Official terms separately name MoneyShow.com, LLC and Investment Seminars, Inc. DBA MoneyShow; do not collapse them into one proven legal entity or assume which will sign a hotel contract. MoneyShow is the organizer/brand; MaRS is the historical event venue; Chelsea is the published official-hotel relationship. No external PCO, DMC or housing bureau was identified in the reviewed material.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Chelsea is the only hotel named on the official accommodation page, creating an incumbent relationship obstacle; its presence does not prove exclusivity or a future contracted block. Historical 2026 programme already included a cocktail reception and refreshments, so moving that spend off-site is not an established opening. No sourced sell-out, compression, overflow shortage, displaced rooms or attendee lodging pickup was found. Do not use total attendance as hotel demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact MoneyShow through Support@MoneyShow.com or +1 941-955-0323, addressed to Mike Marino with Aaron West as senior routing alternative. First request written confirmation of the next Toronto edition’s dates, venue and legal contracting entity; ask for the named event-operations/housing buyer, Chelsea relationship scope and any exclusivity, actual out-of-town speaker/sponsor room needs, peak nights and sourcing timetable. Only then offer a right-sized, separately priced lodging/side-meeting proposal. Do not quote September 16–17, 2027 as confirmed, request speculative inventory holds, or promise catering before hotel operations verifies delivery.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The latest officially documented Toronto edition, September 24–25, 2026, is past: no current-edition sale remains. The proposed 2027 edition has no verified official date, venue or open sourcing path. Accessibility is relationship-led and unqualified, not a live RFP or confirmed available room block.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: retain for conditional future capture because successive Toronto editions are documented, but recurrence alone does not establish a 2027 booking. Seek an incremental speaker/sponsor lodging role or a small independently sourced side event, rather than displacement of the full programme. If a future edition returns to MTCC, the hotel’s supplied location becomes a stronger differentiator; if MaRS continues, test transport and attendee preference before pursuing.
